hypotheses.reasoning: ingest-api v3.31.0 began rolling out at 16:57:06 (#133) and was ready at 16:57:40 (#143). Until then the logs had no errors. The first failure came 37s later (#149), a TypeError reading 'region' of undefined at event-formatter.ts:83, tagged v3.31.0. It repeats (#156, #169, #184) and causes the gateway 500s on POST /v1/events (#161, #170, #191...). The failures are partial (~16%), which fits a new code path that breaks on some payloads (likely events without geo data). Geo-cache stats stay steady (no eviction, normal hit/miss), enrichment-svc returns ok on every request, and events-db is healthy, so the dependencies are ruled out. The disk warning on the gateway (#61) is an unrelated red herring.
Some event payloads may be missing geo/region data. But the errors only appear after v3.31.0, so the new formatter not handling that case is the more likely fault.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll ingest-api back to v3.30.7. Then fix event-formatter.ts:83 to handle a missing geo/region object, and add a test for events that have no geo data before redeploying.
